ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the patterns and connections between entities involved in Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future case.
questions: What are the most common schemes used to commit Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread fraud and corruption, and to hold those responsible accountable. By analyzing data and public records, we can identify patterns and connections that may have gone unnoticed.
